title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Sprinters Stakes, we spot Tokai Teio in the stands wearing an expression both hopeful and anxious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unusually, Yamanin Zephyr is nervous. Daiichi Ruby's aura is truly overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But with Tokai Teio watching, giving a poor performance is out of the question.
